name: Croquet
description: A genteel, impeccably mannered woman in her mid sixties who plays lawn croquet and sings English music-hall numbers, prim with a wicked streak.
build: A slim, upright older woman's frame: straight narrow shoulders, a trim waist, legs of ordinary length, standing very erect.
face: Fair rosy-cheeked skin with fine lines at the eyes, bright blue eyes under silver brows, a neat straight nose, thin lips in coral lipstick, large round pearl earrings.
hair: Short silver-white hair in soft curls, set close to the head under the hat.
outfit: A crisp white collared tennis dress with short sleeves and a pleated knee-length skirt, a wide navy trim band at the hem and collar; a wide-brimmed straw sun hat with a broad navy ribbon band; white tennis shoes; navy short socks.
performance_style: Prim and erect: heels together, toes turned out, weight even. Both arms hang at the sides, the character-right and character-left hands open, empty, every finger visible beside the thighs. Chin slightly lifted, a polite closed-mouth smile.
location: A manicured backyard croquet lawn in soft afternoon light: bright striped mown grass running to the bottom of the frame with hoops and coloured balls, a hedge and a white garden trellis behind, a table with a lemonade jug, and string lights along the hedge.
recognition_cues: a wide-brimmed straw sun hat with a navy ribbon
a white tennis dress with wide navy trim
short silver curls and pearl earrings
avoid: a mallet in the hands in the key art: her hands are empty

sing.intent: Music-hall vocal loop: bob on the toes with a jaunty knee lift, bring the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth, wag the character-left index finger in cheeky time, then return to the prim stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief start at a loud backyard sound: the shoulders jump, the torso draws back and both open hands rise to chest height, then she settles back to the opening stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot self-protection: set the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, and hold a steady finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: stroll in with a stately walk, stop square to the front and set the heels together into the prim stance.
